description: This Java class 'MockOtaUpgradeCluster' extends 'MockCluster' and simulates an OTA upgrade cluster for testing purposes. It manages firmware version attributes and provides methods to retrieve attribute data and firmware version.

classes.name: MockOtaUpgradeCluster
classes.description: A mock class representing an OTA upgrade cluster, used for testing OTA firmware upgrades.

methods.name: MockOtaUpgradeCluster
methods.description: Constructor initializing the OTA upgrade cluster with specified EUI-64, endpoint ID, and firmware version.

methods.name: getAttributeData
